questions.question: In the Parable of the Sower, what happened to the seed that fell on good soil?
options: It grew and produced a crop
questions.answer: It grew and produced a crop

questions.question: What did Jesus do to calm the storm on the sea?
options: He rebuked the wind and told the sea to be still
He stepped out and walked upon the raging stormy water
He spread his cloak across the side of the boat
He lifted up his hands and prayed to the Father
questions.answer: He rebuked the wind and told the sea to be still

questions.question: Jesus said the Kingdom of God is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on the earth.
There is nothing hidden that will not be _____, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
